subject: maths
question: What will be the amount due on ₹36,000 in 2 years when the rate of simple interest for successive years is 8% and 6%, respectively?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹36,000

Time (t) = 2 years

Rate for 1st year (r₁) = 8%

Rate for 2ⁿd year (r₂) = 6%

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times r times t)/(100) 

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)
